title: Comparison Study of Different Tumor Biopsy Method for Sentinel Lymph Node Biopsy in Breast Cancer
brief_summary: Sentinel lymph node biopsy (SLNB) has become a mainstay surgery method in breast cance, and the identified number of sentinel lymph nodes determines its accuracy for axillary status. Retrospective study indicated that preoperative tumor biopsy results in more detected sentinel lymoh nodes. The clinical trail is designed to compare the effect of three tumor biopsy methods (preoperative vacuum-assisted biopsy, core needle biopsy, and intraoperative excisional biopsy) for sentinel lymph nodes.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* clinically lymph node negative breast cancer patients T1-T3

Exclusion Criteria:

* history of breast cancer locally advanced breast cancer and metastatic breast cancer proven axillary lymph node metastasis history of axillary excisional or incisional biopsy, or dissection history of neoadjuvant chemotherapy pregnancy non-consented patients
